invariants: Customer knowledge must be scoped to the relevant product or project version
Known limitations must not be hidden or rewritten as successful behavior
Stale or unverified articles must not be presented as current operational guidance
Self-service guidance must not instruct customers to bypass security, payment, approval or Production controls
Project-specific private information must only be visible to authorized customers
Troubleshooting guidance must distinguish safe customer actions from actions requiring LD support
Support and Change Request paths must remain visible when self-service is insufficient
Handover references must point to the governed handover package rather than duplicate ownership truth
Knowledge content may reduce repetitive support but does not replace incident escalation for security or P0 issues
